objective: Find a freelancer who can build an end-to-end e-commerce platform from scratch within a 3-month timeline and budget of up to 50k INR per month, going from source requirements to a live website.
required_information: What they have worked on previously
qualification_criteria: Able to build an e-commerce platform from scratch
Able to deliver the project end-to-end (from source requirements to a live website link)
Willing to work within the budget of up to 50k INR per month
conversation_rules: Ask what they have worked on previously
Check if they are interested and available
call_end_conditions: Candidate does not meet the timeline or budget requirements
follow_up: Let the owner know if the candidate shows interest
